subject: art-and-design
topicName: The Creative Process From Brief to Outcome

tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on The Creative Process From Brief to Outcome

questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring the creative process from brief to outcome. Annotate your process.
questions.correctAnswer: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to the creative process from brief to outcome, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with the creative process from brief to outcome. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.
questions.correctAnswer: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with the creative process from brief to outcome. Which approaches were most successful and why?
questions.correctAnswer: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on The Creative Process From Brief to Outcome

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Document your complete creative process for a project, from initial starting point to final outcome. Show how you researched, experimented, refined and reflected at each stage. Annotate every decision. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: show a RICH, sustained creative journey; demonstrate independent thinking at every stage; annotate extensively with reflective, analytical language; show how research, experimentation and evaluation shaped the final outcome; present a final piece that is clearly the RESULT of the process shown. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
